patch: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = CAST(CAST(field_value AS REAL) + 400 AS TEXT) WHERE field_name IN ('charitable_contributions','charitable_total') AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
applied_sql: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = CAST(CAST(field_value AS REAL) + 400 AS TEXT) WHERE field_name IN ('charitable_contributions','charitable_total') AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
probe: SELECT d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND tr.tax_year = 2025 AND d.field_name IN ('charitable_contributions','charitable_total')
